plan.notes: Official Plan of Study Grid (Program Sequence), 2026-2027 Catalog. Catalog total is 60-62 units; seed models the minimum-unit (60) path. Requires Robotics Technician Certificate of Achievement (12-13 units) as prerequisite per catalog. Uses MATH A115 for the ELEC A100/MATH A115 option (satisfies OCC AS GE Area 4); the conditional Year 2 Semester 2 math slot then becomes elective units. Unspecified slots are OCC AS GE courses or electives; students select specific courses with a counselor.
